_about: Maintained USF Tampa reporting directory. Only entries with status 'active' and a recent checked_date can be used. Research results never edit this file; a person re-checks the official page and updates it by hand.

routes.reason: USF Libraries publishes its own Maintenance Issue form (under Report a Problem), which takes precedence over the general Facilities route for library buildings.
routes.notes: Form fields have not been inspected; opening the form does not mean the report was submitted.

routes.reason: USF Housing takes non-emergency residence hall maintenance requests through its Submit a Maintenance Request portal (Asset Essentials, NetID sign-in).
routes.notes: The resident signs in and submits on the Housing portal themselves.

routes.reason: USF IT lists help@usf.edu on its Get Help page. Facilities sends card-swipe and phone/internet problems to IT, and Housing says internet or phone issues go to help@usf.edu, not a maintenance request.
routes.notes: Covers residence hall internet/phone too (Housing's published exception).

routes.reason: The Facilities Service Center work-request page tells students reporting a non-emergency maintenance issue in a non-residential building to contact FM-ServiceCenter@usf.edu.
routes.notes: Non-emergency only. Residence halls use the Housing route.

urgent_guidance.message: This may be urgent, so don't use a routine report. If anyone is in danger, call 911. Building emergencies (flooding, power loss, gas smell): Facilities 24/7 at (813) 974-2845. Residence halls: Housing at (813) 974-3446 (8 a.m. to 5 p.m.; after hours contact your RA on duty). University Police main line, 24/7: (813) 974-2628.
